response.overview: SHADOWS OF A NATION is a short documentary that explores and observes the daily Brazilian life – An intimate interview with director Akinola Davies Jr, who becomes our narrator and guide in this story - a voice that emerges from the shadows while the story explores heritage, culture, family and sacrifice.  Similarly to the director's own feature film, the journey follows in the footsteps of a people – now Brazilian - starting in the north, leaving behind your culture and customs, in search of a livelihood in the south, the promised land.
response.title: SHADOWS OF A NATION
